text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown 
campaign—consisting of the Satsuki Sho, 
the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho— is 
finally about to begin.

Gathering the brilliant talents of their 
generation, this supreme race to decide 
the "generation's strongest" is—

It's the once-in-a-lifetime dream stage 
that an Umamusume can only challenge once 
in her life.

"Above all, the first leg, the Satsuki 
Sho, is often contested before an 
Umamusume has fully developed her 
abilities, making innate talent considered 
essential."

I came to watch the Satsuki Sho, 
accompanied by Cheval Grand.

Though she skipped the race, in order to 
make her dream of becoming a "great 
Umamusume" come true—

She thought it was essential to grasp the 
movements of her rivals from the same 
generation.

However, on this day, the race took an 
unexpected turn.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the final corner into the 
homestretch, which Umamusume will seize 
the glory of the Satsuki Sho—

Backed as the heavy favorite today was 
Satono Crown, the brilliant talent 
carrying the family's fervent wish for 
their first-ever GⅠ victory.

Yet with 200 meters to go, an Umamusume 
lying in wait at the back unleashed a 
ferocious late burst, surging to blow past 
the entire pack at once—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Eh... W-Woah...
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And look at Duramente! Here comes 
Duramente from the outside!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Can someone really be this strong?!! Is 
she truly this powerful?!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Satsuki Sho, the first 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
is—Duramente!!!!
(WOOOOOOOO!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A... mazing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: What... was that... just now...?

Cheval Grand stands there dazed, but I 
understand completely how she feels.

For a while after the start, Duramente 
kept a low profile with bated breath, but—

Coming off the final corner, she cast 
aside all tranquility in an instant, 
arrogantly snatching victory away.

Her ferocious running, wild and completely 
overpowering others through pure strength— 
it bore the unmistakable aura of a 
conqueror.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even being here... I felt as if I were 
about to be overwhelmed...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So that's how an Umamusume who wins the 
Triple Crown races...
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Joining us here in the winner's circle is 
Duramente, who achieved a spectacular 
victory today!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"You have conquered the first leg of the 
glorious Classic Triple Crown. Please 
share your thoughts with us."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...Nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
No, um... just thinking how nervous I was, 
or how happy I am to have won, or—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I feel nothing about a foregone 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I run for one simple reason: to show the 
world who is the "strongest"—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Today's race is nothing more than a 
stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one too—that's all there 
is to it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Duramente-san!! Could we talk a bit 
more— Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, did you hear that just now?! That 
"strongest" declaration! Families of 
athletes really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Is the upcoming Derby gonna be Duramente's 
too?! Duraaa! Show us those monster legs 
again――!!
(Waaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... To pursue being the 
"strongest"—so directly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You don't have any doubts at all, do 
you...? Neither in your own strength, nor 
in achieving your goal—your dream...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Am I going to compete against this 
person...? To make my dream come true, I 
have to surpass them...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! It's so frustrating...! But I'm not 
done yet either...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I knew she had the talent... She just 
exceeded my predictions...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Why, isn't this getting interesting? 
Next time, I will be the one--!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-san. Crown-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"She's already looking ahead... Even after 
witnessing a run like that...—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... S-Sorry, is there something...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I guess... I was just overwhelmed... 
Everyone was so amazing...

"To be honest, our rivals' caliber 
exceeded my expectations. However, 
learning that at this stage could even be 
called a stroke of luck."

I'll have to defeat them sooner or later. 
If I'm aiming to be a "great Umamusume," 
it's an unavoidable path.

For the day she would face them head-on... 
I resolved to work hard alongside Cheval 
Grand—
